Name: bolier's Sam and Sebastian Rival Heart Events
Author: bolier
Description:
[center][size=3]This mod adds 6 heart events for Sam and Sebastian and dialogue lines after the player sees the last event.
[/size]           [/center][center][b][size=5]HOW TO INSTALL[/size][/b]
[size=3]1. Download SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Unzip the file into your Mods folder.[/size]

[b][size=5]EVENTS[/size][/b]
[size=3]1. Have 1 heart with Sam and Sebastian. Go to the Saloon between 17:00 and 19:00 on Friday. (ID: 211099001)
2. Have 3 hearts with Sebastian, Abigail and Sam. Go to the Mountain on any day but Friday, Saturday or Sunday between 20:00 and 22:00. (ID: 211099002)
3. Have 4 hearts with Sebastian, Sam and Abigail. Go to the Town between 20:00 and 22:00 on a sunny day in any season but winter. (ID: 211099003)
4. Have 5 hearts with Sebastian, Sam and Abigail. Go to Sam's House between 11:00 and 13:00 on Saturday. (ID: 211099004)
5. Have 6 hearts with Sebastian, Sam and Abigail, and 3 hearts with Leah. Go to the Forest between 22:00 and 23:00 on a sunny day. (ID: 211099005)
6. Have 8 hearts with Sebastian and Sam, and 7 hearts with Abigail. Go to the Town between 21:00 and 23:00 on a sunny Fall day. (ID: [/size][size=3]211099006)[/size][/center]
